questions.question:
Two different positions of the same dice are given below. Which is the number on the face opposite to the face containing 6?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/adbb1a28db7ca87e14f5a524f5802005024bf95c9d874cb8109308d35e91c6cd.png]
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

 

**Logic: If two dice have same face value in given image than their clockwise or anticlockwise wise number/letter are know as opposite number/letter in dice.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a2715fc71a8a1d987a9ae4a64ab8b6408c32cb4ed3332676d02e2feffc5dc0d3.png] 

Opposite pairs

2 ⇔ 5

1 ⇔ 4

3 ⇔ 6

Thus, 3 is the number on the face opposite to the face containing 6.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**

questions.question:
What will come in the place of the question mark ‘(?)’ in the following equation, if ‘×’ and ‘÷’ are interchanged and ‘−’ and ‘+’ are interchanged?

72 + 5 − 42 × 7 ÷ 1 = ?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2381f95ecfcbe7f6eaceba831d02f99bf624c84151895e65ac4d5a630f47ff34.png] 

The given interchange rules are: ‘×’ ↔ ‘÷’ and ‘−’ ↔ ‘+’.

The new equation after interchanging signs is:

72 − 5 + 42 ÷ 7 × 1 = ?

Now, we solve the equation following the BODMAS rule:

= 72 − 5 + __**42 ÷ 7**__ × 1

= 72 − 5 + __**6 × 1**__

= __**72 − 5**__ + 6

= __**67 + 6**__

= 73

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statements:

Some superstars are actors.

Some superstars are writers.

Some actors are producers.

Conclusions:

(I): Some superstars are producers.

(II): Some actors are writers.
questions.solution:
The least possible venn diagram is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/76516778b190718cccb432a9e47cb270c289678f6c00d6c835b5d1f112bf0830.png] 

Conclusions:

(I): Some superstars are producers → False(As, there is no direct relation between them)

(II): Some actors are writers → False(As, there is no direct relation between them)

Thus, Neither conclusion (I) nor (II) follows.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**

questions.question:
Seven people, A, B, L, M, N, S and T, are sitting in a row, facing north(but not necessarily in the same order). Only two people sit between T and M. Only L sits to the right of N. Only one person sits between M and N. B sits at some place to the right of S but at some place to the left of A.

How many people sit between A and S?
questions.solution:
Given:

Seven people, A, B, L, M, N, S and T, are sitting in a row, facing north.

Only L sits to the right of N.

Only one person sits between M and N.

Only two people sit between T and M.

B sits at some place to the right of S but at some place to the left of A.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5aca85dd7c03d09b47e3f57af2c78479cdcff66cc86303f26f497c435922c993.png] 

Thus, 2 people sit between A and S.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4".**
